code_name: City of Huntsville Zoning Ordinance (Appendix, Articles 1-95)
edition: Edition not stated; text read from the Zoneomics mirror, which may lag official amendments
caveats: All text was read from the Zoneomics mirror (https://www.zoneomics.com/code/huntsville-AL/chapter_N), summarized by a fetch model, not from the official Municode or city PDF (huntsvilleal.gov planning page returned 404). Verify against Municode (library.municode.com/al/huntsville) before relying on it.
The ordinance text does not define the short codes. Mapping of AC, HM, DS, M, M2, RO2 is inferred from article titles and should be confirmed against the zoning map legend.

Special exceptions are decided by the Board of Adjustment under 92.5.3 (general criteria 92.5.2: written application, notice and public hearing, finding of no adverse effect on public interest). 92.5.3 lists specific uses only; unlisted uses are not special exceptions. Industrial-relevant listed items: quarries/sand/gravel pits in HI and PI; private airports in industrial districts; commercial heliports in C-3, C-4, Medical and LI; HI-only uses such as abattoirs, asphalt plants, salvage yards; firing ranges; towers; primary solar facilities (max 5 acres) in non-residential districts; metal siding on large non-residential buildings (92.5.3(37)).
Height, setback and lot-coverage values for LI and HI are largely not stated in their articles (Article 73 cross-references were not retrieved).
Airport (Article 63) obstruction and noise rules and Article 73 modifications can override district standards.

Explosives, energetics, rocket propulsion: no district article names them as a use; where chemicals or ordnance manufacturing is listed it is noted. Treat as 'not addressed' unless noted and confirm with Huntsville Planning.

RA was not found as an article in the ordinance table of contents. Also present in the ordinance but not requested: C-B Central Business (Art. 26), Research Park Applications 2 (Art. 54, included here as RPA2), Flood Hazard (62), Airport Obstruction/Noise (63), Slope Development (65).
